scope_note: Housing starts reflect private/non-profit construction and senior-government policy as well as municipal approvals.
interpretation_note: Use the budget line as municipal capacity context only; it is not a claim that planning spending caused housing starts.

scope_note: Transit ridership and budget figures cover different reporting bases in some years; source labels are shown.
interpretation_note: Ridership is a service-use outcome. Net requirement is the tax-supported operating context after service revenue, not cost per ride.

scope_note: Crime Severity Index reflects police-reported crime in the community and is influenced by many factors beyond police activity.
interpretation_note: Community F.I.R.S.T. activity measures show workload and outputs; they should not be treated as proof of broader crime reduction.

scope_note: Asset-condition figures combine observed and age-based condition information. The capital-financing budget is broader than road renewal alone.
interpretation_note: Condition and funding-gap measures help show the scale of the infrastructure challenge; they are not a one-year performance grade.

scope_note: The City is Service Manager for Peterborough City and County. Social Services is much broader than homelessness spending.
interpretation_note: Waitlists, housing placements and By-Name data describe system outcomes/pressure; they should not be attributed to a single City budget line.
